vertex.timing: Xₙ is measured on the state at t = n − 1. The state at t = n is the prepared state χ(Xₙ), not the basis state |Xₙ⟩.
vertex.parametersHelp: ω(x) follows the neighbor order shown in the matrix inspector. Complex entries are [real, imaginary] pairs. β is in radians. Defaults are uniform ω and zero β. Applying parameters resets the simulation; numerical validity is checked on the next request.
vertex.jsonError: Enter valid JSON objects for ω and β.
vertex.applied: Parameters applied. Run or step to validate and simulate.

state.title: QUANTUM STATE AND MEASUREMENT STAGE
state.edgeMeaning: An edge label e = (x, y) represents the coherent scattered ket ηₑ = U|xy⟩. It is not a basis-edge occupation. Conditional states from mixed input become guaranteed pure after the second observed step.
state.vertexMeaning: A vertex label x represents the coherently completed ket χ(x). This is the separate induced vertex model, with a pure conditional state after the first observed step.
state.edgeTiming: Before measurement: ρₙ₋₁ → after measurement: Pₓρₙ₋₁Pₓ / pₓ → after scattering: ρₙ. The displayed node colors are the Born probabilities of the current quantum state.
state.vertexTiming: Before measurement: ρₙ₋₁ → observed basis label Xₙ → preparation: τₓ = |χ(x)⟩⟨χ(x)|. Preparation-label weights qₙ and next Born probabilities qₙP are different quantities.
state.label: Preparation label
state.currentDensity: Current physical density matrix at t = {{step}}
state.afterScattering: State after the complete scattering/preparation step (or initial state at t = 0)

ensemble.title: Ensemble and exact mean
ensemble.help: Uses the current graph, matrices, initial state, strategy and seed. Counts refer to independent trajectories at each time, not a time average along one path. Empirical Born probabilities average conditional states without an additional physical measurement.
ensemble.comparison: Post-step vertex Born probabilities: empirical versus exact
ensemble.heatmapCaption: Rows: time step; columns: vertex. Color encodes empirical post-step Born probability.
ensemble.vertexLabels: Labels index χ(x); different labels may prepare identical quantum states. Counts remain label counts, without approximate atom merging.
ensemble.edgeLabels: Labels index the scattered states U|xy⟩. The label law qₙ differs from the edge Born law Mqₙ.
ensemble.warmstart: A fixed atom-label law is not yet available at this warmstart stage.

markov.title: Markov and quantum-state inspector
markov.edgeConvention: Column-stochastic convention: q_next = M @ q. Rows are destination atoms; columns are source atoms. q₂ retains the complete incoming coherence blocks. Dense inspection is limited to dimension 64.
markov.vertexConvention: Row-stochastic convention: q_next = q @ P. Rows are source labels; columns are destination labels. At step n ≥ 1, qₙ = r₀Pⁿ⁻¹; the next Born law is qₙP. Dense inspection is limited to dimension 64.
markov.edgeAssumptions: Simple loopless graph · static unitaries · fully observed measurement before scattering
markov.vertexAssumptions: Static normalized rank-one preparation instrument · fully observed labels
markov.row: P: source rows → destination columns; q_next = q @ P
markov.column: M: source columns → destination rows; q_next = M @ q
